senses.exPt: Aprender inglês vai melhorar suas perspectivas de emprego.

senses.def: likely to become a particular thing, or to happen
senses.ex: We showed the apartment to several prospective buyers.
senses.exPt: Mostramos o apartamento para vários possíveis compradores.

senses.def: to be successful, especially by making money
senses.ex: The town prospered after the new factory opened.
senses.exPt: A cidade prosperou depois que a nova fábrica abriu.

senses.def: the state of being successful and having money
senses.ex: The new factory brought prosperity to the town.
senses.exPt: A nova fábrica trouxe prosperidade para a cidade.

senses.def: rich and successful
senses.ex: It's a prosperous town with lots of new businesses.
senses.exPt: É uma cidade próspera com muitos negócios novos.

senses.def: the main character in a story, film or play
senses.ex: The protagonist of the novel is a young detective.
senses.exPt: A protagonista do romance é uma jovem detetive.

senses.def: to keep someone or something safe from harm
senses.ex: Sunscreen protects your skin from the sun.
senses.exPt: O protetor solar protege a sua pele do sol.

senses.def: the act of keeping someone or something safe
senses.ex: These gloves give good protection against the cold.
senses.exPt: Essas luvas dão uma boa proteção contra o frio.

senses.def: used to keep someone or something safe from harm
senses.ex: Workers must wear protective glasses in the factory.
senses.exPt: Os funcionários devem usar óculos de proteção na fábrica.

senses.def: wanting to protect someone you love from harm
senses.ex: She's very protective of her younger brother.
senses.exPt: Ela é muito protetora com o irmão mais novo.

senses.def: an event where people show they strongly disagree with something
senses.ex: Thousands of people joined the protest against the new law.
senses.exPt: Milhares de pessoas participaram do protesto contra a nova lei.

senses.def: pleased about something you or someone close to you has done
senses.ex: I'm so proud of you for finishing the race!
senses.exPt: Estou muito orgulhoso de você por terminar a corrida!

senses.def: in a way that shows you are proud
senses.ex: She proudly showed us the photos of her new baby.
senses.exPt: Ela nos mostrou com orgulho as fotos do bebê.

senses.def: to show that something is true
senses.ex: Can you prove that you were at home that night?
senses.exPt: Você consegue provar que estava em casa naquela noite?

senses.def: to be found to be something after a time
senses.ex: The test proved to be harder than we expected.
senses.exPt: A prova acabou sendo mais difícil do que esperávamos.

senses.def: shown to be true or to work well
senses.ex: This is a proven method for learning new words.
senses.exPt: Este é um método comprovado para aprender palavras novas.

senses.def: a short well-known saying that gives advice or says something true
senses.ex: My grandmother knew a proverb for every situation.
senses.exPt: Minha avó conhecia um ditado para cada situação.

senses.def: to give someone something they need
senses.ex: The hotel provides free towels for the pool.
senses.exPt: O hotel oferece toalhas de graça para a piscina.

senses.def: only if
senses.ex: You can borrow my car provided you drive carefully.
senses.exPt: Você pode pegar meu carro emprestado desde que dirija com cuidado.

senses.def: one of the main areas that some countries are divided into
senses.ex: Canada is divided into ten provinces and three territories.
senses.exPt: O Canadá é dividido em dez províncias e três territórios.

senses.def: the act of giving people something they need
senses.ex: The provision of clean water is the city's main priority.
senses.exPt: O fornecimento de água potável é a principal prioridade da cidade.

senses.def: a part of a law or contract that says what must happen
senses.ex: The contract has a provision for early cancellation.
senses.exPt: O contrato tem uma cláusula de cancelamento antecipado.

senses.def: supplies of food and other things needed for a journey
senses.ex: The climbers carried enough provisions for two weeks.
senses.exPt: Os alpinistas levavam mantimentos suficientes para duas semanas.

senses.def: conditions or rules in a law or legal agreement
senses.ex: The contract includes provisions for early cancellation.
senses.exPt: O contrato inclui cláusulas para cancelamento antecipado.

senses.def: intended to make people react, argue or think
senses.ex: The article asked some provocative questions about education.
senses.exPt: O artigo fez algumas perguntas provocativas sobre educação.

senses.def: intended to make someone sexually interested
senses.ex: She wore a provocative dress to the party.
senses.exPt: Ela usou um vestido provocante na festa.

senses.def: in a way meant to cause a reaction, argument or desire
senses.ex: He provocatively suggested that exams should be abolished.
senses.exPt: Ele sugeriu, de forma provocativa, que as provas fossem abolidas.

senses.def: to cause a reaction, or to make someone angry on purpose
senses.ex: The new law provoked angry protests across the country.
senses.exPt: A nova lei provocou protestos revoltados pelo país todo.

senses.def: to move around quietly, especially looking for something to catch
senses.ex: A fox was prowling around the chicken coop last night.
senses.exPt: Uma raposa estava rondando o galinheiro ontem à noite.

senses.def: the state of being near something
senses.ex: We chose the hotel for its proximity to the beach.
senses.exPt: Escolhemos o hotel pela proximidade com a praia.

senses.def: the mind, or the deepest thoughts and feelings of a person
senses.ex: Fear of failure is deeply rooted in the human psyche.
senses.exPt: O medo de fracassar está profundamente enraizado na psique humana.

senses.def: connected with the treatment of mental illness
senses.ex: He spent several weeks in a psychiatric hospital.
senses.exPt: Ele passou várias semanas num hospital psiquiátrico.

senses.def: a doctor who treats mental illness
senses.ex: After months of anxiety, he finally saw a psychiatrist.
senses.exPt: Depois de meses de ansiedade, ele finalmente foi a um psiquiatra.

senses.def: connected with the mind and how it works
senses.ex: Stress can cause both physical and psychological problems.
senses.exPt: O estresse pode causar problemas físicos e psicológicos.

senses.def: in a way that is connected with the mind
senses.ex: Losing his job affected him psychologically.
senses.exPt: Perder o emprego o afetou psicologicamente.

senses.def: a person who studies the mind and helps people with problems
senses.ex: She talks to a psychologist once a week.
senses.exPt: Ela conversa com um psicólogo uma vez por semana.

senses.def: the study of the mind and how it affects behaviour
senses.ex: My sister is studying psychology at university.
senses.exPt: Minha irmã está estudando psicologia na faculdade.

senses.def: a place where people go to drink and meet friends
senses.ex: Let's meet at the pub after work.
senses.exPt: Vamos nos encontrar no bar depois do trabalho.

senses.def: for everyone to use, or owned by the government
senses.ex: Is there a public bathroom near here?
senses.exPt: Tem um banheiro público aqui perto?

senses.def: buses, trains and other vehicles that everyone can use
senses.ex: I use public transport to get to work every day.
senses.exPt: Uso o transporte público para ir ao trabalho todos os dias.

senses.def: the act of making a book, report or article available to the public
senses.ex: The publication of the report was delayed until next month.
senses.exPt: A publicação do relatório foi adiada para o mês que vem.

senses.def: attention from newspapers, TV and the public, or activity to get it
senses.ex: The film got a lot of publicity before it came out.
senses.exPt: O filme teve muita divulgação antes de ser lançado.

senses.def: to tell the public about something
senses.ex: The band used social media to publicize their new album.
senses.exPt: A banda usou as redes sociais para divulgar o novo álbum.

senses.def: in a way that everyone can see or hear
senses.ex: He apologized publicly for his comments.
senses.exPt: Ele pediu desculpas publicamente pelos seus comentários.

senses.def: to print a book, magazine, etc. and sell it, or to put it online
senses.ex: Her first novel was published in 2015.
senses.exPt: O primeiro romance dela foi publicado em 2015.

senses.def: a company that prepares and sells books or magazines
senses.ex: She sent her first novel to several publishers.
senses.exPt: Ela enviou seu primeiro romance para várias editoras.

senses.def: a soft sweet dish, often made with milk, eggs or chocolate
senses.ex: My mother makes a delicious chocolate pudding.
senses.exPt: Minha mãe faz um pudim de chocolate delicioso.

senses.def: in British English, sweet food eaten at the end of a meal
senses.ex: What's for pudding tonight?
senses.exPt: O que tem de sobremesa hoje à noite?

senses.def: to move something towards you using your hands
senses.ex: Don't pull the cat's tail, it hurts him!
senses.exPt: Não puxe o rabo do gato, isso machuca ele!

senses.def: a warm knitted piece of clothing for the top of the body
senses.ex: Put on a warm pullover before you go out.
senses.exPt: Vista um suéter quente antes de sair.

senses.def: the regular beat of blood that you can feel, for example in your wrist
senses.ex: The nurse checked my pulse and blood pressure.
senses.exPt: A enfermeira mediu meu pulso e minha pressão.

senses.def: a machine that pushes liquid or air into or out of something
senses.ex: I need a pump to put air in my bike tyres.
senses.exPt: Preciso de uma bomba para encher os pneus da minha bicicleta.

senses.def: a large round orange vegetable with a hard skin
senses.ex: My grandmother makes a delicious pumpkin soup.
senses.exPt: Minha avó faz uma sopa de abóbora deliciosa.

senses.def: to hit someone or something hard with your closed hand
senses.ex: He got angry and punched the wall.
senses.exPt: Ele ficou bravo e deu um soco na parede.

senses.def: a hard hit with a closed hand
senses.ex: The boxer was knocked down by a single punch.
senses.exPt: O boxeador foi derrubado com um único soco.

senses.def: a drink made by mixing fruit juice, sometimes with alcohol
senses.ex: There was a big bowl of fruit punch on the table.
senses.exPt: Tinha uma tigela grande de ponche de frutas na mesa.

senses.def: arriving or doing something at the expected time, not late
senses.ex: Please be punctual, the meeting starts at nine.
senses.exPt: Por favor, seja pontual, a reunião começa às nove.

senses.def: the habit of arriving or doing things at the expected time
senses.ex: The company values punctuality above everything.
senses.exPt: A empresa valoriza a pontualidade acima de tudo.

senses.def: marks such as commas and full stops used in writing
senses.ex: Check your spelling and punctuation before you finish.
senses.exPt: Confira a ortografia e a pontuação antes de terminar.

senses.def: to make someone suffer because they did something wrong
senses.ex: His parents punished him for lying to them.
senses.exPt: Os pais dele o castigaram por ter mentido para eles.

senses.def: something done to someone because they did something wrong
senses.ex: As a punishment, he wasn't allowed to watch TV.
senses.exPt: De castigo, ele não pôde ver TV.

senses.def: a child who goes to school
senses.ex: The school has about three hundred pupils.
senses.exPt: A escola tem cerca de trezentos alunos.

senses.def: the small black circle in the middle of the eye
senses.ex: The doctor checked the pupils of my eyes with a light.
senses.exPt: O médico examinou as pupilas dos meus olhos com uma luz.

senses.def: a young dog
senses.ex: Our dog had five puppies last week.
senses.exPt: Nossa cadela teve cinco filhotes semana passada.

senses.def: something you buy, or the act of buying it
senses.ex: Keep the receipt in case you want to return your purchase.
senses.exPt: Guarde o recibo caso queira devolver a sua compra.

senses.def: to buy something
senses.ex: You can purchase tickets online or at the door.
senses.exPt: Você pode comprar os ingressos pela internet ou na entrada.

senses.def: not mixed with anything else
senses.ex: This shirt is made of pure cotton.
senses.exPt: Esta camisa é feita de algodão puro.

senses.def: to make something clean by removing dirty or harmful things
senses.ex: This machine purifies the water from the river.
senses.exPt: Esta máquina purifica a água do rio.

senses.def: the quality of being clean and not mixed with anything
senses.ex: The purity of the water is tested every day.
senses.exPt: A pureza da água é testada todos os dias.

senses.def: the colour you get when you mix red and blue
senses.ex: My favourite colour is purple.
senses.exPt: Minha cor favorita é o roxo.

senses.def: the reason why something is done
senses.ex: What is the purpose of your visit?
senses.exPt: Qual é o objetivo da sua visita?

senses.def: on purpose: because you wanted to, not by accident
senses.ex: I'm sure he broke the window on purpose.
senses.exPt: Tenho certeza de que ele quebrou a janela de propósito.

senses.def: showing that you know what you want to do
senses.ex: She walked into the meeting with purposeful steps.
senses.exPt: Ela entrou na reunião com passos decididos.

senses.def: a woman's handbag (American English)
senses.ex: She keeps her phone and keys in her purse.
senses.exPt: Ela guarda o celular e as chaves na bolsa.

senses.def: a small bag for money (British English)
senses.ex: She took a coin out of her purse.
senses.exPt: Ela tirou uma moeda da carteira.

senses.def: to try to do or get something over a long time
senses.ex: She wants to pursue a career in music.
senses.exPt: Ela quer seguir carreira na música.

senses.def: to follow someone in order to catch them
senses.ex: The police pursued the thief through the streets.
senses.exPt: A polícia perseguiu o ladrão pelas ruas.

senses.def: the act of trying to get or achieve something
senses.ex: Many people move to big cities in pursuit of a better life.
senses.exPt: Muitas pessoas se mudam para cidades grandes em busca de uma vida melhor.

senses.def: the act of chasing someone to catch them
senses.ex: The thief ran off with two police officers in pursuit.
senses.exPt: O ladrão fugiu com dois policiais em sua perseguição.

senses.def: an activity you do for pleasure
senses.ex: The area is popular for outdoor pursuits like hiking and climbing.
senses.exPt: A região é procurada para atividades ao ar livre, como trilha e escalada.

senses.def: to press something with your hands to move it away from you
senses.ex: Can you help me push the car?
senses.exPt: Pode me ajudar a empurrar o carro?

senses.def: to press a button or switch
senses.ex: You need to push the green button to start.
senses.exPt: Você precisa apertar o botão verde para começar.

senses.def: to move something to a particular place
senses.ex: Put the milk in the fridge, please.
senses.exPt: Coloca o leite na geladeira, por favor.

senses.def: a game or toy that you have to think about to solve
senses.ex: My son loves doing jigsaw puzzles.
senses.exPt: Meu filho adora montar quebra-cabeças.

senses.def: something that is difficult to understand or explain
senses.ex: How he escaped is still a puzzle to the police.
senses.exPt: Como ele fugiu ainda é um mistério para a polícia.

senses.def: confused because you cannot understand something
senses.ex: She looked puzzled when I told her the news.
senses.exPt: Ela pareceu confusa quando eu contei a notícia.
